name: 飞雷神锚点
description: 水门的回合结束时，在7格内选择一处合法位置作为飞雷神锚点，最多保留三个。
skillCode: var minato = context.rulePiece; if (!minato || minato.currentHp <= 0 || battle.turn.currentPlayerId !== minato.ownerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; function legalCells() { return battle.map.tiles.filter(function(tile) { if (!tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return false; if (Math.abs(tile.x - minato.x) + Math.abs(tile.y - minato.y) > 7) return false; return !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === tile.x && piece.y === tile.y; }); }).map(function(tile) { return { type: 'cell', x: tile.x, y: tile.y }; }); } if (context.targetX === undefined || context.targetY === undefined) { var candidates = legalCells(); if (!candidates.length) return { success: false, message: '' }; return { needsTargetSelection: true, targetType: 'cell', range: 7, filter: 'all', playerId: minato.ownerPlayerId, title: minato.name + '选择飞雷神锚点', canCancel: false, targetCandidates: candidates }; } var x = context.targetX; var y = context.targetY; var valid = legalCells().some(function(cell) { return cell.x === x && cell.y === y; }); if (!valid) return { success: false, message: '飞雷神锚点位置不合法' }; if (!battle.extensions) battle.extensions = {}; if (!battle.extensions.minatoAnchors) battle.extensions.minatoAnchors = []; if (!battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = []; var anchors = battle.extensions.minatoAnchors; var existing = anchors.find(function(anchor) { return anchor.sourceId === minato.instanceId && anchor.x === x && anchor.y === y; }); if (existing) existing.createdAt = Date.now(); else anchors.push({ x: x, y: y, sourceId: minato.instanceId, ownerPlayerId: minato.ownerPlayerId, createdAt: Date.now() }); battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(effect) { return !(effect.tileType === 'flying-raijin-anchor' && effect.sourceId === minato.instanceId && effect.x === x && effect.y === y); }); battle.extensions.tileEffects.push({ x: x, y: y, sourceId: minato.instanceId, tileType: 'flying-raijin-anchor', icon: '⚡', bgColor: 'rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.14)', boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.75)', iconPosition: 'top-left' }); while (anchors.filter(function(anchor) { return anchor.sourceId === minato.instanceId; }).length > 3) { var oldest = anchors.filter(function(anchor) { return anchor.sourceId === minato.instanceId; }).sort(function(a, b) { return (a.createdAt || 0) - (b.createdAt || 0); })[0]; anchors = anchors.filter(function(anchor) { return anchor !== oldest; }); battle.extensions.minatoAnchors = anchors; battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(effect) { return !(effect.tileType === 'flying-raijin-anchor' && effect.sourceId === minato.instanceId && effect.x === oldest.x && effect.y === oldest.y); }); } return { success: true, message: minato.name + '标记飞雷神锚点(' + x + ',' + y + ')' };
